reason: I don't book anyone my family or a neighbour hasn't actually used -- an app badge saying someone is 'verified' doesn't tell me the plumber won't flood my kitchen. I've been burned by a JustDial number that just went dead, so a profile and a price on a screen isn't enough for me to let a stranger into my house.
objection: Who are these freelancers really, and will there even be enough of them near me in Coimbatore -- or will I open the app for a weekend repair and find two tutors and nobody else?
would_change_my_mind: If someone in my own WhatsApp group or a neighbour actually used a hithozha freelancer and vouched for them by name, I'd consider booking that same person through the app.
